chapters.label: The final
chapters.text: Wembley, the Euro 2020 final, extra time. Henderson finds Raheem Sterling on the left. Sterling drives into the box and tries to pass to Kane… But Giorgio Chiellini is there. Blocked! Corner.

chapters.label: The replay
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Chiellini covers the middle, right where the pass must go. He stretches, and blocks it.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal: off his boot, and out. England’s big chance is gone.

chapters.label: The lesson
chapters.text: That’s teamwork. Chiellini was always talking to his partner, Bonucci. Defenders: talk to your partner, and cover each other!
